title: Choose PK-Hub's new visual world
question: The roll assigned Stamp Paper for the console. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Stamp Paper
options.lineage: Pakistani non-judicial stamp paper and banknote security print
options.thesis: Every run is issued like a numbered security document: serial, denomination, validation.
options.viewport: Intaglio-green portal rail; on a pale guilloché-tinted ground the search form, a launch bar, and the run panel headed by the run's red serial and a rosette that draws ring by ring as pages are read.
options.risk: Guilloché turns into wallpaper if it leaves the rosette and the rail edge; then the console reads as a banknote costume.

raised.raise: Results tables run at true data density: tabular numerals, tight rows, columns that drop from the edges on small screens.
History is a serial register: runs in strict serial order, and the serial is the run's name everywhere.
A real type ramp: the run's counts set at poster scale beside caption-size labels.
Serial red is reserved for the run in flight and nothing else; every other state uses the state palette.

options.label: Tender Notice
options.lineage: the tender notices pages of Dawn and Jang
options.thesis: The console set like a newspaper's tender page: every tender in its own ruled notice box.
options.viewport: A masthead strip with the date line; the search form as one ruled notice block; results as boxed notices in a column grid.
options.risk: Broadsheet-editorial is one of the looks AI interfaces fall into, and the console it replaces already leans that way.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each run is a coupon that gets stamped, never erased: validated, used, void.
options.viewport: Carrier-navy top bar; filters as ruled fare boxes; each run a tear-off coupon whose state is stamped across it.
options.case: Stamped states fit 'never hide a partial result' exactly; loses on audience, since air travel is not the bid team's world.
options.risk: Coupon chrome can crowd a dense filter form.

options.label: Transit Line
options.thesis: A run is a journey along a line: queued, opening, page by page, packaged, arrived.
options.viewport: Midnight-blue header and rail, each portal its own line colour; the run panel draws the run as a line with stations lit as it reaches them.
options.case: Run progress as stations is the clearest live-state picture here; loses on audience, as metro maps are not the bid team's world.
options.risk: A dark enamel shell is heavy in a daylit office, and line colours must never be mistaken for status colours.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The run as a strobing field of barcode columns.
options.viewport: A black field of bar columns with the results as dense numeric columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a bid team does not see itself in gallery data art, and strobing hides run state.
options.kept: Data-density courage: tables at true density with tabular numerals.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every run a catalog entry known by its number.
options.viewport: A black index of numbered runs with labels encoded as colour strips.
options.case: Fuses poorly: replacing names with codes works against a team that must read tender titles fast.
options.kept: Strict sequence: the run's serial is its name and history is the index.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Portals as flat colour tiles under giant lowercase type.
options.viewport: A black panorama of portal tiles with cropped headings.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tiles and panoramas fight a long filter form and dense tables.
options.risk: Navigation by tile is slow for daily work.
options.kept: Type-ramp courage: headline numbers at poster scale.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The run as a purple course over fixed terrain.
options.viewport: A terrain-coloured form with the active run overprinted in purple.
options.case: Fuses poorly: map terrain says nothing about tenders, and the palette has no home in Pakistani office life.
options.kept: One reserved ink for the active item only.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern admin console, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, white cards, one indigo accent, the arrangement every operator expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other dashboard by design.
